vo_figure_coverage_adult_holistic.evidence: At thumbnail and native scale, one clearly adult subject occupies the full composition from mature face and head through both grounded boots.

vo_figure_coverage_stable_opaque_path.evidence: At both scales, one solid cobalt S-shaped panel forms an unbroken opaque path from the upper frame to the floor while covering the central clothed torso and pelvis.

vo_figure_coverage_contour_continuity.evidence: At native scale, visible shoulder, waist, hip, thigh, and leg segments align plausibly around both panel edges, and the panel reads as a freestanding occluder instead of a pasted bar.

vo_figure_coverage_light_negative_space.evidence: At thumbnail scale, strong diagonal left-side light models the face, arms, suit, and panel, while clear body-bounded voids remain around the raised arm, bent outer arm, waist, and separated legs.

vo_figure_coverage_complete_pose.evidence: At both scales, the head, torso, raised arm, bent arm, both legs, both supporting boots, and asymmetric standing pose remain readable together in one uncropped whole-figure frame.

supplemental_observations.reference_scope: Only visible adult facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and natural skin texture were considered; identity and same-person status were not assessed.
